The '''Manoe system''' was located in the [[Manoe sector/Legends|Manoe sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Gultanna system/Legends|Gultanna system]] in the [[Vadigult sector]] and the [[Dohu system/Legends|Dohu system]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Dohu sector/Legends|same name]]. By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Manoe system lay within territory controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Manoe system was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square K-7.<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', noted on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]] that Manoe was created for "bookkeeping purposes" so that every sector listed in the Online Companion would have at least one corresponding system,<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref> although the [[Grehollo system/Legends|Grehollo system]] was also placed in the Manoe sector.<ref name="EAOC" />
